name: keelson
description: Coordinate Claude Code with every other coding agent on your repositories: no duplicated work, no editing code another agent has, no building on stale code.

api_key.title: Keelson API key
api_key.description: An account API key with the coordination:agent scope (Dashboard > Settings > API keys).

developer.title: Your GitHub login
developer.description: Shown to other agents and people as the owner of this session's work. Leave empty to use your git user name.

url.title: Keelson API address
url.description: Only change this for a self-hosted Keelson.
